thoughts: Every day with you in it is a good day — even the ones we haven't met in yet.
Somewhere between your first hello and your last goodnight, you became my favorite thought.
If I had a flower for every time you crossed my mind, I'd be walking through a garden forever.
Your laugh is still my favorite sound in the whole world.
You make ordinary days feel like something worth remembering.
I hope today is soft to you, the way you are soft with the world.
99.9% was never just a number to me. I'm still quietly earning that 0.1%.
The stars held a meeting last night. They agreed — you outshine them all.
If you ever wonder whether you're on my mind… you never left it.
You don't have to be perfect. You just have to be you. That's always been more than enough.
Some people search their whole lives for what I found the day I met you.
Your smile could end wars. It certainly ends my bad days.
Today's reminder: you are someone's answered prayer. Mine, specifically.
I'd lose sleep for you a thousand nights over. July 7th proved that.
The world is a little brighter because you're in it — and you don't even try.
Whenever you feel small, remember: you're the whole reason this little world exists.
Your heart is the safest place I've ever known.
I don't need a special day to celebrate you. But I'll happily take every one I can get.
If being adorable were a crime, you'd be serving a life sentence.
You're the calm in my noisy days and the thought I keep coming back to.
Even on your quietest days, you're still the loudest thing in my heart.
I hope someone made you smile today. If not — I hope this line did.
Distance means nothing when someone means everything.
You have a way of making the whole day feel softer. I hope today returns the favor.
I still replay the day we held hands. I held on a little tighter after that.
Being yours is my favorite thing to be.
If hearts had doors, yours would be the one I'd knock on every day.
You're not just in my thoughts today. You're the whole headline.
This site has a song, and it will always be playing for you.
Some days you just need to hear it: you did well today. Rest now.
Your name still gives me that quiet, happy feeling. Divine. Fitting, honestly.
I could listen to you talk for hours — about anything, about nothing.
You're the plot twist my story needed.
If I could bottle the way you make me feel, I'd call it 'Divine' and keep it forever.
Today's forecast: 100% chance of you being thought about.
You make my heart do that thing. You know the one. It never stops doing it around you.
Wherever you are right now — I hope today is being gentle with you.
You're proof that the best things in life aren't things.
I hope you ate something today. I hope you drank water. I hope you know you're loved.
Every love story is beautiful, but ours is my favorite.
You walked into my life and quietly redecorated the whole thing.
If you're reading this at night — sleep well, sweet Divine. Tomorrow is already thinking of you.
If you're reading this in the morning — good morning, beautiful. Today loves you already.
One day I'll run out of ways to adore you. Today is not that day.
Your kindness is the kind that stays with people. It stayed with me.
I don't say it enough: thank you for existing exactly as you are.
You're my favorite notification. Always have been.
Some people light up a room. You light up entire weeks.
I still can't believe you're real sometimes.
Wherever life takes you, a little corner of the internet is always here, always yours.
You had my curiosity at hello. Then you had my heart.
The best part of my day is whichever part includes you.
I hope today gives you back a fraction of the joy you give people.
You're not a chapter in my story. You're the whole book.
Keep blooming, Divine. The world needs your kind of beautiful.
Today, tomorrow, always — I'm quietly in your corner, cheering for you.
If you ever doubt yourself, come back here. This whole site is proof of what you mean to someone.
You make me want to be better, just so I deserve being near you.
There are 86,400 seconds in a day. You've crossed my mind in at least 86,000 of them.
Keep this little world on your phone. It works without internet — like my feelings for you. No signal required.
smileNotes: You said 99.9% like it was nothing. I've been protecting that number like a national treasure ever since.
'First guy to ever hold your hand.' Six words. One memory. Replayed about a million times since.
The day you told me I was the first to hold your hand, I held on a little tighter. You probably noticed. I definitely did.
You kept 0.1% of your trust just to tease me. Keep it forever — it means I'll keep trying forever.
99.9% has a whole shrine in my head. The remaining 0.1% is under construction. We do not give up here.
The night I stayed up for midnight on July 7th, I came second. Best second place of my entire life.
I stayed up past midnight for you once. I'd do it a thousand more times. Sleep and I have negotiated this.
You laughed when you said 99.9%, like you were keeping something from me. You were keeping my sanity. It worked.
Somewhere in Ilesa right now is the girl who owns my whole heart. I hope her weather is as good as she is.
Ilesa doesn't know how lucky it is. It gets to have you while I count down to 200lvl.
200lvl is just a fancy way of saying 'the part where I get to see you again.' That semester is circled in my heart.
I'm counting down to 200lvl in the most polite way possible. It's taking everything in me.
Your hand fit in mine like an answered question. I still think about that.
One day we'll be old and I'll still be telling people the 99.9% story. Practice your eye-roll now.
You're the reason my notifications matter.
Your smile could fix a bad day in under a second. It's fixed most of mine.
If thinking about you paid money, I'd have bought an island by now. A nice one.
Some people are sunshine. You're the whole season.
From your very first hello to right now, you quietly became my favorite habit.
You're the plot twist my story needed — and the one I'd never rewrite.
My heart does a roll call every morning. Yours is the only name on the list.
You could read a grocery list and I'd call it poetry.
You're the soft part of all my days.
Even your typing style has charm. Where did you learn that?
You're proof that quiet people carry the loudest hearts.
If I had to describe perfect, I'd just type your name and send it.
You're not on my mind. You've rented the whole place — permanently, no complaints.
Your existence is my favorite coincidence.
Everything is better with you in it. Including Tuesdays. Especially Tuesdays.
You're the reason the future doesn't scare me anymore.
You're the only person whose 'LOL' I picture as a real laugh — because I've heard it, and it's better.
Every chat with you is my favorite thread. I reread the good ones like a series.
You make 'good morning' texts feel like breaking news.
If the universe takes requests, mine was granted the day you said hello.
You're not 'a lot.' You're exactly enough — all of it, exactly.
Your standards and your self-respect are attractive. Keep every last one of them.
Talking to you is my favorite hobby, sport, and productive waste of time. All three at once.
You're the quiet good news my day is always waiting for.
You care about people so quietly they don't even notice. I notice. I always notice.
Your kindness doesn't announce itself. It just quietly redecorates every room you enter.
You're smart in a way that makes everyone around you a little smarter.
You have that rare thing — a beautiful face and an even more beautiful heart. No filters needed, in either sense.
Your name is Divine. It's the most accurate name I've ever heard.
Your parents named you perfectly. I'm just the guy who noticed.
Your mind is my favorite place to visit. The conversations there never really end.
You're someone's answered prayer. Mine, specifically. I checked.
You didn't just walk into my life — you moved in, and I never wanted the space back.
Your smile is my favorite sight in any room, in any city, at any hour.
If hearts had home addresses, mine moved into yours without asking.
You're the reason I believe in good timing, even when it's slow.
Being loved by you would be an honor. Loving you already is.
You're the kind of person people don't forget. I'm living proof.
Your heart must be the softest place on earth. Everything about you suggests it.
You're the best thing that ever happened to my standards. Nobody else will ever clear this bar.
You're the reason I check my phone like it owes me money.
Scientists studied my heart once. They found your name and closed the case.
My brain said 'stop thinking about her.' My heart said no. My brain said fair enough.
If missing you were a degree, I'd have graduated top of the class by now.
You're the reason my 'do not disturb' has trust issues.
I'd share my last suya with you. In this economy, that's a marriage proposal.
My camera roll is 90% things you'd find funny. The other 10% is screenshots of this website.
You're the reason I smile at my phone in public like a weirdo. Zero regrets.
If you were a WiFi signal, you'd be full bars everywhere you go. That's real power.
You're the reason I actually reply on time now. Character development.
Teachers warned me daydreaming would ruin my life. Then you happened. Totally worth it.
You're my favorite distraction. The expensive kind — you cost all my attention.
I'd fight a bear for you. I'd lose, but I'd fight so hard the bear would feel bad.
'One more message' has ruined my sleep schedule since I met you. Best trade I ever made.
You're the reason a whole website exists. Blame yourself.
There are nine photos of you on this site and about four thousand more in my heart. Rough estimate.
Every time you tap the screen and hearts float up — that's this little world saying it likes you too.
This jar never runs empty. Unlike my data. Please manage both wisely.
I built you a whole world and you still somehow make my real one better. Overachiever.
Your laugh should come with a warning label: 'may cause permanent attachment.'
I'd tell you my worst joke just to hear you laugh at how bad it is. Wait — I already do that.
Your laugh is free to hear and worth more than everything I own.
Your smile has been scientifically proven* to fix bad days. (*Source: me. Every single day.)
If smiling were a superpower, you'd be out here saving entire cities and not even noticing.
You've been in my head so long you should pay rent. Kidding. Stay forever. Rent-free.
There's a counter on this site that's been ticking since July 7th. It's counting for both of us.
'Birds of a Feather' will always remind me of this little place — and of you. Both feel like home now.
There's music playing somewhere on this site just for you. There always was.
Future plans: hold your hand again. Possibly build you another website. In that order. Maybe.
When we finally see each other again, I'm going to act calm. This entire site is evidence against me.
I hope 200lvl has long walkways. I have catching up to do — starting with your hand in mine.
Every heart floating on this site is yours. The floating ones, the falling ones — all of them.
This note is one of ninety. I could write ninety more before dinner. Don't test me. Test me.
You're the reason this little world exists — and my favorite part of the real one.
One day I'll run out of things to adore about you. It will not be today. It will not be any day.
The jar has ninety notes and not one of them is an exaggeration. I checked. Twice.
